buildCommand: export MIGRATE_URL="${DIRECT_DATABASE_URL:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL}}}"; if DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATE_URL" prisma migrate status 2>&1 | grep -q 'up to date'; then echo 'Migrationen aktuell - Schritt uebersprungen'; next build; else (DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATE_URL" prisma migrate deploy || (sleep 20 && DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATE_URL" prisma migrate deploy)) && next build; fi
